posts.author: NichnotFound
posts.body: Hello everyone! I'm doing a chapter-based game on RPG Maker MV. During cutscenes, when i select the option "Change Image" in the Movements tab, the sprite disappears for a moment before reappearing. The cutscene does work, yes, but still, it's very ugly the way it works. The youtube link is a video of the cutscene itself.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: That's because the new sprite image has to load in. Using a preloader plugin usually can get rid of it. You could also try "preloading" it by Changing the image and changing it back immediately during the fade in when the player enters the map, though that may not work due how aggressive the garbage collection in RM is.
